articles.title: Crypto exchange Kraken is trying to become a bank in Europe
articles.snippet: Kraken's focus is on Lithuania as the jurisdiction to secure the license, according to a person familiar with the plans.

articles.title: U.S. SEC to propose crypto rule as soon as this month to ease startups, fundraising
articles.snippet: A newly updated agenda from the securities regulator shows so-called Reg Crypto high on its near-term list.

articles.title: Vanguard opens search for digital assets leader in sign of evolving crypto strategy
articles.snippet: The new role would oversee tokenization, stablecoins and blockchain initiatives as Vanguard reassesses digital assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin stalls as open interest decline raises questions about rally's staying power
articles.snippet: BTC retreated from a two-week high of $64,500 as falling open interest and weak spot demand cast doubt on the sustainability of July's 8.4% advance.

articles.title: Binance taps into Bitcoin holders’ hunger for yield with new covered call yield play
articles.snippet: The product, called BTC Yield, is designed exclusively for people who already hold bitcoin.
